stories.title: Priority histogram
stories.acceptance: Create src/metrics.js (JSDoc + export function priorityHistogram(jobs) returning {[priority]:count} with default 0) and 2 node:test tests in test/metrics.test.js.

stories.title: Dead-letter rate
stories.acceptance: In src/metrics.js export function failureRate(pending, dead) returning Number((dead/(pending+dead)).toFixed(4)) or 0 when total===0; add 2 tests in test/metrics.test.js.

stories.title: Min priority view
stories.acceptance: Create src/filter.js (JSDoc + export function filterMinPriority(jobs, min) returning jobs with (job.priority ?? 0) >= min) and 2 node:test tests in test/filter.test.js.

stories.title: Multi-tag filter
stories.acceptance: In src/filter.js export function filterByTags(jobs, tags) returning jobs whose job.tag is in tags ([] when tags empty); add 2 tests in test/filter.test.js.

stories.title: JSON serializer
stories.acceptance: Create src/snapshot.js (JSDoc + export function serializeJobs(jobs) returning JSON.stringify({version:1, jobs})) and 2 node:test tests in test/snapshot.test.js.

stories.title: Snapshot parser
stories.acceptance: In src/snapshot.js export function deserializeJobs(raw) parsing JSON, checking version===1 and Array.isArray(jobs) else throwing Error; add 2 tests in test/snapshot.test.js.
